title: Lesson 1 Quiz: What Is a Bank, Really?

questions.text: What does the bank helper write next to your name in the notebook?
options: The exact number of coins you gave her
questions.explanation: The helper writes your name, and next to it the exact number of coins you gave her.

questions.text: Rain cannot wet the money inside the bank's vault.
questions.explanation: The narration says rain cannot wet the money in the vault.
